thread:
Maya R: Quick heads-up — integrator handed back staging with failed image pulls, says 'network lockdown' hit when nodes tried to pull our runtime images. Need architecture triage before their go-live window.
Liam T: Can you paste the exact error they saw?
Maya R: Partner reports: `unauthorized: authentication required` + `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority` in different nodes.
Andrea S: Two separate failure modes. unauth could be registry creds or auth proxy; x509 is cert chain. Are they pulling from an internal mirror?
Maya R: Yes, their mirror is `registry.internal.corp` behind a firewall appliance.
Samir K: Oncall: I can repro in our staging cluster if you give me a node to test from. @ops-bot start debug run.
ops-bot: debug-run initiated by Samir K — collect logs and tcpdump. artifact: s3://redwood-debug/2629004567/ (will update when complete)
Liam T: If the appliance is terminating TLS, intermediate certs sometimes get stripped. Ask partner to `openssl s_client -showcerts -connect registry.internal.corp:443` and paste output.
Andrea S: Also request `docker pull --debug` output. If registry uses SNI that doesn't match CN, some older CNI/proxy setups drop the handshake.
Maya R: Partner asked about temporary mitigations — they need something fast for go-live in 48h.
Samir K: Recommend two options: (1) pre-pull and host images on their air-gapped mirror (2) deploy a transparent proxy sidecar that rewrites TLS to present correct certs — sidecar needs security signoff.
Liam T: Short-term we can also add registry's cert fingerprint to our node trust store as a stopgap, but that requires their security team sign-off.
Andrea S: Action items: Andrea to collect cert bundle + `openssl` output, Samir to run reproduce in staging, Liam to draft runbook steps for workaround, Maya to coordinate integrator comms. Target: 48h.
Paul (Integrator): (external) Thanks folks — sending certs and a basic network diagram now. We're opening a firewall SR and will try pre-push as fallback.
Maya R: Good — if firewall SR takes long, please start pre-push. Also please include the appliance vendor logs (TLS termination) if available.
Samir K: If we need to escalate to infra-eng for custom allowlist changes, ping me and I'll loop them in.
Liam T: Note for runbook: include `curl -v https://registry.internal.corp` and `openssl s_client` checks, plus docker error patterns. I'll add before EOD.
Maya R: I'll update customer-success and our go-live tracker once we confirm pre-push or sidecar choice. :thumbsup:
Andrea S: Acked — opening a ticket and attaching requests to partner.
Maya R: Thanks team — will post certs + logs when they arrive and circle back.
